'''Naval Supply''' was part of the [[Analysis (Alliance Intelligence)|Analysis]] sub-branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence's]] [[Intentions]] branch. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ioth]] served in this department during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
